method.confidence: 22 samples/path for revised ordinary blocks; 44 for retained ordinary blocks. method.rulesScope: Top-level rules are the frozen revised ordinary effective rules. Only the listed revisionScope was re-simulated under that snapshot; retained blocks use baseline rules referenced by baselineRulesReference.
method.weighting: Overall ordinary win rate pools actual attempts, so each retained 44-sample Sequence has twice the weight of each revised 22-sample Sequence. The equal-Sequence mean is separately reported.
method.immutability: Baseline ordinary-finish-final.json and wanted-finish-final.json are read-only sources; superseded results remain available with their original profile/source/report hashes.

baselineRulesReference.interpretation: Top-level rules describe the frozen revised ordinary run. Only revisionScope was re-simulated under those rules; retained results use the original effective rules in these immutable baseline reports.

summary.overallConfidenceNote: No pooled confidence interval is supplied for this mixed source/profile snapshot compilation. Per-Sequence shared-scenario intervals and cohort Wilson intervals retain their source report interpretation.
